{{Quote|Why could't we keep our old armor? A'int nothin' Neo about me, anyway!|Gummig to [[Deedoh]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic: War 4">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 4|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Gummig''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who fought in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and then during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], serving under command of [[Mandalorian Knights|Mandalorian Knight]] [[Dorjander Kace]] during the [[Battle of Halthor]]. He disliked the [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader armor]], complaining how much of it didn't work for him, making him wish he had his old armor.
